hook.name: TokenFab
hook.description: A token launch platform hook that operates bonding curves for newly deployed ERC-20 tokens. When a token's bonding curve supply is exhausted, liquidity is automatically migrated to a standard AMM pool. Charges a 5% fee on every swap (1% platform, 1% creator, 3% reward pool) taken via afterSwapReturnsDelta. External liquidity additions, removals, and pool initialization are all blocked.
